securityPolicies.name: Zod Validation

securityPolicies.description: Generation endpoints never write files to the repository

securityPolicies.name: Server-Side Credentials
securityPolicies.description: LLM provider credentials never leave the server process
securityPolicies.enforcement: process.env read inside route handlers only

securityPolicies.name: Untrusted Agent Output
securityPolicies.description: Generated artifacts are rendered as escaped plain text, never as markup
securityPolicies.enforcement: React text nodes inside preformatted blocks
